content:
The audit logic failed to correctly calculate missing events and aggregate summary totals across Excel and Word outputs.
The test_formatted_data_logic failed with 'assert 0 == 1' when checking the missing event flag (out[8]). In test_summary_sheet_matches_expected, actual rows did not match expected values, specifically showing ('WH-A', 'CarrierX', 1, 0, 1) instead of (..., 6, 0, 6). Additionally, test_word_summary_content failed because the expected total '12' was missing from the generated Word document text. These failures indicate a systemic error in how the script processes plan_rows against latest_completed data.
